WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT team1 as team, match_winner FROM Matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 as team, match_winner FROM Matches
)
SELECT 
  team,
  COUNT(*) as matches_played,
  SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as win_percentage
FROM team_matches
GROUP BY team
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 5;
